title: Arrested at school for snacks
text: A 13-year-old with disabilities was arrested at school for allegedly shoplifting snacks.

title: 238 days, then charges dropped
text: A child aged 10 to 14 spent 238 days on remand before the charges were dropped.
source_title: ABC: NAAJA youth justice submission (3 Feb 2026)

title: Adjourned three times
text: A NAAJA client spent nearly two weeks on remand because no interpreter was available; his case was adjourned three times.

title: Handcuffed on a commercial flight
text: Children held in an adult transfer facility were handcuffed and flown to Darwin. One young person moved from Alice Springs was seriously assaulted by multiple detainees and has ongoing medical complications.
source_title: ABC: NAAJA youth justice submission (3 Feb 2026)

title: 11-year-old sprayed in a police van
text: The NT Ombudsman found police sprayed an 11-year-old boy, hooded and handcuffed in the closed cage of a van, after he spat at officers; he was 'in extreme distress' (year to confirm).

title: Kumanjayi White
text: A Warlpiri man, 24, with disabilities and under state guardianship, died after police restraint in an Alice Springs supermarket. His family are calling for justice and transparency.
consent: Named publicly by family; use the family's framing

title: Kin turned away by housing rules
text: Composite drawn from NAAJA's submission: a grandmother asks to care for her grandchildren but is refused because her name is not on the lease and the house has too few bedrooms.

title: Septic maintenance and a child's death
text: Coronial findings said two-year-old Kumanjayi Fly's death in Mount Liebig could have been prevented by septic maintenance.

title: From care to the watch house
text: Composite: a 12-year-old in residential care runs from placement, is picked up by police at night, held in a watch house and remanded because no bail address is approved.

title: Coniston
text: Families and Warlpiri, Anmatyerr and Kaytetye people name more killing sites than the Board of Enquiry recognised.

title: Kept 'like birds in a cage'
text: Testimony to Bringing Them Home describes girls in the Kahlin dormitories.

title: From absence to a SmartCard
text: Composite: a mother whose son misses school after a family funeral is referred to income management; half her payment moves to the card.
